author: willai3213
title: Seeking graphic designer / character visual designer for Taipei exhibition
content: Looking for a collaborator for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition collateral, plus pre-press checks. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking exhibition/graphic design experience with a hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers: comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact via Threads DM/comments.
